defaults.video_script: October 2024. Vinicius Junior is on a plane to Paris, ready to collect the Ballon d'Or. Real Madrid have been told he has won it. Then, hours before the ceremony, the news changes. Rodri of Manchester City has won instead. The plane never takes off. Real Madrid boycott the entire gala, nobody from the club attends, and Vinicius posts seven words. I will do it ten times over.
